tasks.label: Send code on simulator start
tasks.detail: Starts automatically. Press Start in the Wokwi tab and your code is sent.

tasks.label: Send code now
tasks.command: python3 -m mpremote connect port:rfc2217://localhost:4000 fs cp main.py :main.py + soft-reset
tasks.detail: Send main.py without waiting. The simulator must already be running.

tasks.label: Open a MicroPython prompt
tasks.detail: Type Python straight at the board. Ctrl-] to leave.
